oneOf.description: Gordon Growth Model: TV = FCF_terminal × (1 + g) / (WACC - g)

stable_growth_rate.description:
Perpetual stable growth rate as an annual decimal (e.g., 0.02 for
2%). Must be < WACC.

oneOf.description:
H-Model: linear fade from high growth to stable growth (Damodaran).

```text
TV = FCF_T × (1+g_s)/(WACC-g_s) + FCF_T × H × (g_h-g_s)/(WACC-g_s)
```

where `H` is the half-life in years of the high-growth fade period.
The first term is the standard Gordon Growth stable-state value;
the second term captures the present value of excess growth that
linearly decays from `high_growth_rate` to `stable_growth_rate`
over `2 × half_life_years`.

half_life_years.description: Half-life of the growth fade in years (e.g., 5.0).

stable_growth_rate.description: Long-run stable growth rate (e.g., 0.03 for 3%). Must be < WACC.

description: Headline DCF assumptions: decimal WACC, terminal value, unlevered free cash flow node and optional net-debt override.

net_debt_override.description:
Flat net-debt amount in model currency used instead of the
model-derived equity bridge; `None` (the default) derives net debt
from the model's debt and cash.

terminal_value.description: Terminal-value convention applied after the explicit forecast period.

ufcf_node.description:
Node id containing monetary unlevered free cash flow for forecast
periods (default [`DEFAULT_UFCF_NODE`], `"ufcf"`).

wacc.description: Weighted average cost of capital as a decimal (`0.10` means `10%`).
